strings.name: Kristo Käärmann
strings.summary: Estonian entrepreneur Kristo Käärmann cofounded TransferWise, later Wise, with Taavet Hinrikus. With teams, he developed cross-border payments and multi-currency services. His career also includes consulting and a regulatory disclosure penalty.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Service launch and incorporation, rebranding and listing, and FCA disclosure and HMRC tax penalties are distinguished. Business statements remain attributed.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Wise, advancing online cross-border payment infrastructure and international transfers for people and businesses.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Tartu graduation records show a master’s in informatics on September 15, 2006; the company biography also lists a bachelor’s degree.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early work
strings.facts.f2.value: Before Wise, consulted at Deloitte and PwC and participated in bioinformatics and data-mining research.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Cross-border payment services
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Hinrikus and teams, developed transfers, multi-currency accounts and payment infrastructure; collective results are not individual inventions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Business and regulatory responsibility
strings.highlights.h2.text: While leading expansion, received a 2024 penalty for failing to disclose personal tax matters appropriately to the FCA; distinct from the earlier HMRC fine.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Half-year results released
strings.timeline.t1.text: Wise publishes H1 FY27 results with his CEO statement; reporting period ends September 30, with board responsibility signed November 12.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Company begins Nasdaq trading
strings.timeline.t2.text: New group parent shares begin Nasdaq trading, retaining a secondary London listing; a company and team milestone.
strings.timeline.t3.title: FCA imposes penalty
strings.timeline.t3.text: Final Notice imposes £350,000 for inadequate disclosure of personal tax matters in 2021; press release follows the next day.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Wise lists directly in London
strings.timeline.t4.text: Participates from Tallinn with Hinrikus; direct listing differs from a traditional fundraising IPO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Announces Wise brand
strings.timeline.t5.text: Signed article announces TransferWise becoming Wise as account and payment services expand; website transition follows.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joint entrepreneurship award
strings.timeline.t6.text: Shares EY Entrepreneur Of The Year UK award with Hinrikus; report acknowledges team contributions.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Launches TransferWise jointly
strings.timeline.t7.text: Launches international transfers in London with Hinrikus; service launch year is not an exact incorporation date.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns informatics master’s
strings.timeline.t8.text: University of Tartu graduation list records the master’s degree; not a doctorate.
